Amarnath Yatra to Begin on July 3, Concerns Over Baba Bhranji's Darshan

The Amarnath Yatra is set to begin on July 3, with concerns surrounding the first darshan of Baba Bhranji. The yatra has been marred by controversy over the past few days, with some pilgrims expressing fears about the safety and sanctity of the site. The Indian government has assured that all necessary measures are being taken to ensure a smooth and peaceful journey for the pilgrims.
